# CHAESSI PRESET v3.9.1

Official Windows x64 Portable ZIP. Extract the executable and four signature/manifest files together. Select the new EXE in [Reader v1.1.1](https://github.com/DooMokDdongGae/Chaessi-Metadata-Reader/releases/tag/v1.1.1) to connect.

- Retains four V5 Precise reference types and the independent single/set library.
- Preserves PNG responses and bridges actual returned strings for Inspect-compatible WebP conversions; latest-result and History Save retain stored bytes.
- Offers cancel or explicit discard for unsaved image edits while retaining running/saving protection.
- Excludes 365 unnecessary upstream test/development files at packaging time, keeping required runtime, licenses and help.
- Keeps the production trust root and chaessi.prompt-transfer/1. Compatible signed Preset updates do not require rebuilding Reader each time.

This update improves generated-PNG metadata preservation and unsaved-edit confirmation when closing, and removes unnecessary development files from the package. Four downloaded PNGs were recognized by the official Inspect UI. Types without original Precise/Character PNG samples, some save-time busy timing and limited external-image paths remain known limitations. Existing History is not batch repaired and missing generation data is never inferred.

Existing token, preset, History and library paths are retained. Close old versions normally, back up user data separately and extract the whole ZIP to a new folder. Withdrawn v3.9.0/v3.8.5 Releases and tags are not restored. [Updating](../../docs/UPDATING.md).
